text:
alex: Quick thread to propose a Galaxy Quickstart Marketplace kit (TF-first). Goal: a single opinionated starter that covers VPC, instance pool, inference runtime, monitoring, and a marketplace metadata bundle. Target: prototype + CI by EOW. Thoughts?
mina: great. please include a compatibility matrix for x86, Graviton (ARM64), and Ampere. partners will ask which AMIs/instance-families we recommend.
chen: agree on matrix. let's design modules so outputs follow a standard prefix: `galaxy_` (e.g., `galaxy_vpc_id`, `galaxy_inference_lb`). helps downstream packaging.
pat: add security items early: SBOM, minimal IAM policies, and a secrets guidance doc. marketplace reviews fail fast on overly broad roles.
alex: checklist idea: repo scaffold, modules/{vpc,instances,inference,monitoring}, examples/, profiles/{tiny,standard,prod}, marketplace/metadata.json, smoke CI, security-scan step, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.
mina: for perf notes, include short guidance: e.g., "use Graviton2 for cost-sensitive small models; Ampere for throughput; quantized fp16/INT8 caveats". also add a sample perf table in profiles.
chen: sample module usage (will add to README):
```
module "inference_pool" {
  source = "../modules/inference"
  model_id = "redwood/llama-13b"
  replicas = 2
  instance_type = "m6g.large"
  tags = { project = "galaxy-quickstart" }
}
```
chen: modules should accept `provider_alias` + `region` overrides so partners can pin to partner accounts.
pat: packaging-bot: what schema do we want for marketplace metadata?
packaging-bot: packaging-bot: recommend `marketplace/metadata.json` with fields: name, description, support_contact, supported_regions (list), supported_architectures (list), billing_notes, compliance_tags. also include `packaging/validate.sh` to lint the file.
ci-bot: ci suggestion: .github/workflows/smoke.yml -> runs on PR -> steps: checkout, hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1, terraform fmt, terraform validate, terraform init -backend=false, terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan, run `packaging/validate.sh`, run `vuln-scan` (container or tfsec). upload artifacts.
mina: add a small local benchmark script under `bench/` that can be run against a dev runtime or partner preview env. keep it bash + curl to measure p95 latency for N requests.
alex: owners: @alex + @mina for first week. @chen will own module API patterns. @pat owns security & packaging checklist. timeline: prototype by Wed, CI green Thu, partner smoke Fri.
chen: I'll draft module input/output conventions and create an RFC in repo.
pat: will prepare a minimal IAM policy snippet and a list of required audit logs for Private deployments.
mina: also note in README the recommended quantization settings and links to Redwood Optimize docs.
alex: ok — I'll create the repo (github.com/redwood-inference/galaxy-quickstart-kit) and open PR with scaffold. please leave short reviews. tag partner-eng when we have a green CI for validation. :sparkles:
